# Copilot Instructions

This repository's AI agent instructions are tool-neutral and live in
**[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** — read that. GitHub Copilot looks for
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` specifically, so this file exists only to point there. Do not
add instructions here; edit `AGENTS.md` so every agent (Claude Code, opencode, Copilot) stays in
sync.
